policy: Record only observations actually performed on the exact revision and stated OS, including failed checks. Bundling, typechecks and React Native Web are not device verification.

checks.procedure: Open sheet at both snap points; rotate; confirm title and footer avoid notch and home indicator.

Focus first/last input, enter Japanese, scroll and dismiss keyboard; verify focused field and submit remain reachable, no double inset: inside a lifted bottom sheet the KeyboardAwareSheetFooter bottom edge stays on the sheet bottom edge (just above the keyboard), not floating over the body or title. In Combobox / MultiSelect, type into the search field and, with the soft keyboard still shown, tap a candidate once; verify it is selected on the first tap (Combobox closes, MultiSelect row toggles). In a Screen (scroll, default avoidKeyboard) with number-pad inputs (inputAccessoryViewButtonLabel="完了") in the lower half of a long form, at standard and largest text size: tap a lower field; verify the whole field box moves above the keyboard and the 完了 / 次へ button does not overlap the field (iOS), and on Android (edge-to-edge, keyboard does not resize the window) the field is above the keyboard. With the keyboard still shown, move to another lower field via 次へ or by tapping; verify it is revealed too. Tap the last field; verify it can be revealed. Scroll the form by finger while the keyboard is shown; verify it is not pulled back to the field. Dismiss the keyboard; verify no blank space remains under the content. Open a Sheet with a text input placed inside the Screen children; verify the Screen behind does not jump. Repeat with a number-pad input with 完了 in the Sheet and record whether the Screen behind shifts while the keyboard is shown and returns after it closes (iOS RN ScrollView behavior for inputs with an accessory bar outside the scroll view).

Set OS accessibility text size to largest, reopen app; verify full labels wrap and controls remain reachable. PillToggle (issue #861): at each iOS text size (standard 1.0 / standard max 1.353 / accessibility 1.786, 2.143, 2.643, 3.571 as RN fontScale), check 2-, 3- and 4-option toggles with and without fullWidth and with count; no label is truncated with an ellipsis or overlaps a neighbour, items stay side by side up to 1.786 and stack vertically from 2.143, and VoiceOver still reads role button and selected. Tab bar (issue #862, LiquidBottomTabBar / createExpoRouterTabBar): tab labels stop growing at about the standard maximum (maxFontSizeMultiplier 1.35) so four 4-character Japanese labels are not truncated, the accessibility label stays the full name, and at accessibility sizes a long press shows the label in the iOS Large Content Viewer.
Drag handle between 0.5 and 0.9, scroll inner content, dismiss and reopen five times; ensure no invisible input-blocking modal.
Enable VoiceOver/TalkBack; verify names, modal focus, field labels and close action.

observations.notes: 項目1への日本語入力後、ソフトキーボードで保存フッターが隠れた。
